why: Every bracket in the figure turns 90 degrees clockwise in each step (open-top becomes open-right, then open-bottom, then open-left). Turning each bracket of B once more gives top row: open-bottom, open-left; bottom row: open-top, open-right. That is option 1. Option 2 has the same four shapes but in the wrong places.
trick: When small shapes sit in a 2x2 grid, follow ONE corner across the row and see how it turns.
